searchText: Do people have any great flows for running Hive with a binary that's located on the host machine, i.e. w/o having to go through the 2x Dockerization (1 to build the client image, 2 to build the hive-client image?) Is there a reason contract addresses aren’t just the hash of the bytecode? Seems like it would save space and make finding contract addresses easier You mapreduce the contract to save the contract code once and move the state somewhere else so people can have multiple instances of it
